newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk treasury won't borrow by Oct-end - state min.
newsitem.headline: Turk treasury won't borrow by Oct-end - state min.

text.p: The Turkish treasury was not in a short-term cash need and would not borrow in domestic markets through t-bill sales by the end of this month, state minister Ufuk Soylemez said on Wednesday.
"The treasury will not borrow from domestic markets in the next two weeks. It will continue to borrow in line with its cash needs from November," Soylemez told Reuters.
The treasury has no domestic debt repayment by October 30, when it will service 140 trillion lira of outstanding debt. It will repay 360 trillion lira in November and 350 trillion in December.
